zh: 难怪路上这么堵，原来在修路。
old_en: No wonder the road is so congested; they're repairing it.
new_en: No wonder the road is so busy; they're fixing it.

zh: 难怪手机没信号，原来附近在施工。
old_en: No wonder his phone had no signal; they were doing construction nearby.
new_en: No wonder there's no signal; they're building nearby.

zh: 难怪店关门了，今天是老板的退休派对。
old_en: No wonder the store is closed today; it's the boss's retirement party.
new_en: No wonder the shop is closed; it's the boss's retirement party today.

zh: 难怪味道这么熟悉，原来是妈妈做的菜。
old_en: No wonder the food tastes so familiar; it's Mom's cooking.
new_en: No wonder the food tastes so familiar; it's Mom's cooking.

zh: 难怪房间这么干净，原来是刚打扫过。
old_en: No wonder the room is so clean; it was just cleaned.
new_en: No wonder the room is so clean; it was just cleaned.

zh: 怪不得他生气，你今天又迟到了。
old_en: No wonder he's angry; you're late again today.
new_en: No wonder he's angry; you're late again.

zh: 怪不得他生气，你总是迟到。
old_en: No wonder he's angry; you're always late.
new_en: No wonder he's upset; you're always late.

zh: 难怪屋里这么冷，原来窗户一直开着。
old_en: No wonder it's so cold inside; the window has been open all along.
new_en: No wonder it's so cold; the window has been open.

zh: 难怪屋里这么热，原来空调开得太高。
old_en: No wonder it's so hot in here; the air conditioning was set too high.
new_en: No wonder it's so hot; the AC is set too high.

zh: 难怪他没来，原来生病了。
old_en: No wonder he didn't come; he was sick.
new_en: No wonder he didn't come; he was sick.

zh: 难怪他没来，原来他去看医生了。
old_en: No wonder he didn't come; he went to see a doctor.
new_en: No wonder he didn't show up; he went to see a doctor.

zh: 难怪这么便宜，原来是旧款。
old_en: No wonder it's so cheap; that explains why it's an old model.
new_en: No wonder it's so cheap; it's an old model.

zh: 难怪衣服上有洞，原来是件旧衣服。
old_en: No wonder the clothes have holes; they are old ones.
new_en: No wonder there are holes in the clothes; they're old.

zh: 难怪东西这么便宜，原来快过期了。
old_en: No wonder the prices are so low, that explains why the goods are nearly expired.
new_en: No wonder it's so cheap; it's nearly expired.

zh: 难怪他迟到，原来闹钟没响。
old_en: No wonder he was late; the alarm didn't go off.
new_en: No wonder he's late; the alarm didn't go off.

zh: 难怪他这么累，原来加了一周的班。
old_en: No wonder he's so tired; he worked overtime for a whole week.
new_en: No wonder he's so tired; he worked extra hours all week.

zh: 难怪他没回消息，原来手机没电了。
old_en: No wonder he didn't reply; his phone ran out of battery.
new_en: No wonder he didn't reply; his phone ran out of power.

zh: 怪不得他这么着急，原来快迟到了。
old_en: No wonder he's so anxious; that explains why he's running late.
new_en: No wonder he's so anxious; he's almost late.

zh: 难怪店关门了，原来老板退休了。
old_en: No wonder the store closed; the owner retired.
new_en: No wonder the store is closed; the owner retired.

zh: 难怪今天没人排队，原来是工作日。
old_en: No wonder today there's no one in line, it's a weekday.
new_en: No wonder there's no one in line today; it's a weekday.
